question: If 20% of 90% of 5over9 of a number is 345. Find the number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert percentages and fractions into a single multiplier.

20% × 90% × 5/9 ⇒ (1/5) × (9/10) × (5/9)

Multiplying the terms: (1 × 9 × 5) / (5 × 10 × 9) = 1/10

If 1/10 of the number is 345, then the total number is 345 × 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 3450.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Result = 345

Percentages = 20% and 90%

Fraction = 5/9

**Formula Used:**

Value = Number × (P₁/100) × (P₂/100) × Fraction

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3fed50550ba7fa1119546b1c37d893b891bcbb3b70475c9e83c56062fa84107.png] 

Let the number be x.

⇒ x × (5/9) × (90/100) × (20/100) = 345

⇒ x × (5/9) × (9/10) × (1/5) = 345

⇒ x × (5 × 9 × 1) / (9 × 10 × 5) = 345

⇒ x × (1/10) = 345

⇒ x = 345 × 10

⇒ x = 3450

**∴ The correct answer is 3450.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To simplify calculations, convert common percentages: 20% = 1/5, 25% = 1/4, 50% = 1/2, and 10% = 1/10.

Successive Percentage Application

When multiple percentages are applied to a single base, the net multiplier is the product of individual fraction equivalents: Net % = (P₁ × P₂ × ... × Pₙ).

Reverse Percentage Calculation

If the final value is given and the original is required, multiply the final value by the inverse of each multiplier: Original = Final × (1/M₁) × (1/M₂).
